en: Multi-view color postcard with four photographs separated by black borders and a small city emblem in the center. The top-left image shows a large square with a former mosque topped by a green dome (Pasha Qasim Mosque) in a historic city center with hills and a TV tower in the background. The top-right image shows a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall towers and a statue standing in front (Pécs Cathedral). The bottom-left image shows another domed former mosque with a minaret beside a pink building and trees. The bottom-right image shows medieval stone castle walls and a round tower with a statue in front. The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, a 60 fillér Magyar Posta cactus stamp, a circular postmark reading 'PÉCS 1978 VIII 29', pricing information and publisher credit in Hungarian, and an address panel.
